instruction: I've decided to use my full name, Michael Anderson, as my Chrome profile name. Please change the profile name to Michael Anderson.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing Chrome profile name to 'Michael Anderson' (full name with space). Uses existing get_profile_name getter and exact_match metric. Same complexity as original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts profile name from Chrome Preferences file (profile.name field)
Metric correctly performs exact string comparison for profile name verification
Expected value 'Michael Anderson' semantically matches the instruction requirement
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the single requirement (profile name change)
Data flow is correct: user changes profile → Chrome writes to Preferences → postconfig restarts Chrome → getter reads Preferences → metric compares
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure preferences are persisted to disk
Edge cases handled: null/empty profile names and partial matches will correctly fail
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider increasing postconfig sleep from 3 to 5 seconds to ensure Chrome has sufficient time to fully restart and write preferences on slower systems (this is a robustness improvement, not a logical flaw)
